title: 安娜·王：就业增长门槛降低，市场需适应新常态
speaker: Anna Wong

segments.en: Yeah, so he mentioned this break even concept.
segments.zh: 是的，他提到了这个盈亏平衡的概念。

segments.en: So economists estimate this monthly pace of job growth that's needed to keep the unemployment rate constant, and Kevin Hassett just mentioned his estimate is 40,000.
segments.zh: 经济学家估算维持失业率稳定所需的月度就业增长步伐，凯文·哈塞特提到他的估算是4万。

segments.en: Our estimate is around 55,000. The Fed in a recent note, they think that it's closer to zero.
segments.zh: 我们的估算约为5.5万。美联储在最近的报告中认为接近零。

segments.en: So I think that's what he's trying to, Kevin Hassett is trying to say to kind of his point is that while we are used to the 100K type of monthly payrolls print going forward,
segments.zh: 所以我认为凯文·哈塞特想表达的是，虽然我们习惯了每月10万级别的就业增长，

segments.en: even a soft ones that's between zero to 50,000 and in his mind, 40,000 is actually a tolerable and decent kind of number of job growth.
segments.zh: 即使是在0到5万之间的疲软数据，在他看来，4万也是可以接受且不错的就业增长。

segments.en: And I think basically he's lowering the bar for what constitutes a good labor market.
segments.zh: 我认为他基本上是在降低好劳动力市场的标准。
